text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the morning, intending to get an early 
start on work, I was heading to the 
Trainer's Room when I spotted Daiichi 
Ruby.

text_block_list.name: Ruby's Butler
text_block_list.text:
"—Well then, I shall come to pick you up 
at 18:00 today as well."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Yes, I shall be waiting.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Daiichi Ruby seems busy lately. It 
appears she's had a string of parties she 
has to attend."
choice_data_list:
(I wonder if there's anything I can do to 
help...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thinking that, I checked the schedule that 
had been shared in advance. While doing 
so, an idea suddenly struck me.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...And who might this be?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I inputted all the necessary values into 
the training equipment before Daiichi Ruby 
arrived.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you for your assistance.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Just what did you...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At lunchtime, I secured seats in the 
cafeteria before Daiichi Ruby arrived.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I don't know if it's actually helping, 
but— it's got to be better than doing 
nothing.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thinking that, I decided to carry the 
equipment beforehand so we could start 
smoothly before training. However—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (—Skiiid!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Was I pushing myself harder than I 
thought—? Unable to bear the weight of the 
equipment, my foot slipped...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: ――! Are you alright?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Wah, you've got a scratch...! Let's head 
to the infirmary right now!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Can you stand? There's no rush, take your 
time, so please don't push yourself...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my... It appears the school nurse is 
not present.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Alright, let's patch it up ourselves— 
...Huh?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: What is that thing on the table?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking in the direction Mejiro Ryan was 
looking, disinfectant and gauze were 
already prepared. Along with an 
expensive-looking ointment I had never 
seen before...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
My, this ointment is extremely valuable, 
you know.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It is highly effective, but 
expensive, and unobtainable without 
placing a special order.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Come to think of it, Ruby-chan was 
watching from afar earlier, wasn't she?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Could it be that Ruby-chan prepared it 
for you, Trainer?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"No, she is my trainee, so I thought it 
might happen! Though, I'm not really 
sure..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though I found it strange, given the 
circumstances, it was the only 
explanation... For now, I decided to make 
use of the ointment.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before long—the results showed 
immediately.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Good day. Let us begin today's training.
choice_data_list:
That wound from the other day is all 
healed up!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...A wound?
choice_data_list: It's all thanks to that ointment.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though not yet certain it was hers, I told 
her on the hunch that it was. And then—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
………… If I was of help to you, then that is 
more than enough.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At those words of affirmation, their 
cheeks relaxed into a smile.
choice_data_list: I'll be careful from now on, okay?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...No. If it is due to my errands, there 
is no need for you to push yourself.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: It's just—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed, training efficiency has 
improved. You have my gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hearing their words of thanks brought 
warmth to their heart, and they thought to 
themselves that they wanted to keep doing 
everything they could to help for as long 
as they were able.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was so happy with what she did that I 
accidentally let out a loud shout.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...I'm quite accustomed to treating 
injuries, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Is that why she was able to prepare 
first-aid supplies so quickly? Even so, I 
was grateful for her prompt action.
